name: stellar-upto-http-v2
assertions: paymentRequirements.amount becomes the actual usage amount
payer authorization covers payTo, token, max_amount, validity, facilitator, settlement_id, request_digest
facilitator authorization covers settlement_id, actual, result_digest
actual must be between zero and max_amount
replay of payer and settlement_id is rejected
wrong payTo, requestDigest, contract, asset, network, or expiry is rejected
